title.en: A range account with a date attached
title.zh: 有年代边界的分布记录

text.en: The 2016 IUCN assessment described a discontinuous range of more than 2.6 million km², from southern Senegal across the forest belt north of the Congo River to western Tanzania and western Uganda. It described four subspecies ranges. This is a dated assessment account, not a current range map.
text.zh: IUCN 2016 年评估记载，黑猩猩分布区不连续，面积超过 260 万平方公里，从塞内加尔南部沿刚果河以北的森林带延伸至坦桑尼亚西部和乌干达西部，并分别描述四个亚种的分布。这是一份有明确年代的评估记录，不是当前分布图。

title.en: What one forest-edge study found
title.zh: 一项森林边缘研究的发现

text.en: At Bossou, Guinea, researchers followed one wild western chimpanzee community for up to six hours a day from April 2012 to March 2013, including 10 adult focal individuals. Mature forest was the most selected habitat overall. Among feeding events in uncultivated habitat, records more than 200 m from fields exceeded chance expectations, while the 0–200 m bands fell below them. The authors suggested field-associated risks may shape feeding locations; this is a local result, not a species-wide habitat rule.
text.zh: 在几内亚 Bossou，研究者于 2012 年 4 月至 2013 年 3 月跟踪一个野生西部黑猩猩群体，每天至多观察 6 小时，焦点样本包括 10 只成年个体。总体上，成熟林是选择比例最高的栖地。在非耕地栖地记录的取食事件中，距耕地超过 200 米的次数高于随机预期，0–200 米范围内则低于预期。作者提出耕地相关风险可能影响取食地点；这是当地群体的结果，不是全物种的栖地规律。

title.en: A task-specific view of learning stick use
title.zh: 从特定任务观察棍棒使用

text.en: At Taï National Park in Côte d’Ivoire, a cross-sectional video study recorded 1,460 stick-use events from 70 wild western chimpanzees in three neighboring communities. In a model of grips used to insert sticks, the multi-digit grip became predominant at about 5.2 years, with a 98% predicted probability of use by age 15. Only three females from one community contributed observations above 45 years. The pattern describes this extractive-foraging task and sample; it is not a universal developmental curve or proof of a cognitive cause.
text.zh: 在科特迪瓦 Taï 国家公园，横断面视频研究记录了三个相邻野生西部黑猩猩群体中 70 只个体的 1,460 次棍棒使用事件。针对棍棒插入动作的握法模型估计，多指握法约在 5.2 岁成为主导，到 15 岁时预测使用概率为 98%。45 岁以上的观察仅来自一个群体的 3 只雌性。这一模式只描述所研究的取食任务与样本，不能当作普遍发育曲线，也不能证明认知成因。

title.en: Growing up and first births at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝种群的成熟与首次生育

text.en: Long-term records at Gombe National Park in western Tanzania covered 36 known-age wild females. Their mean age at sexual maturity was 11.5 years; mean age at first birth was 14.9 years. First-birth estimates came from a smaller, censored subset in which non-dispersing females were overrepresented, so they may be biased low. These are estimates for one population, not fixed values for every chimpanzee.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚西部贡贝国家公园的长期记录纳入 36 只已知年龄的野生雌性黑猩猩。其性成熟平均年龄为 11.5 岁，首次生育平均年龄为 14.9 岁。首次生育估计来自更小且包含删失记录的子样本，其中未迁出的雌性比例偏高，因此估计值可能偏低。这些是一个种群的估计，不是每只黑猩猩都遵循的固定数值。

title.en: Why captive body-mass comparisons need context
title.zh: 圈养体重比较需要什么背景

text.en: A study compared 298 chimpanzees in African sanctuaries, 1,030 in zoos and 442 in research facilities. After age adjustment, adult animals in zoos and research facilities had greater body mass than sanctuary animals in both sexes; estimated growth was slower in the sanctuary cohort. The groups included mixed or unknown subspecies and different care settings, so this comparison cannot stand in for wild morphology or a subspecies comparison.
text.zh: 一项研究比较了非洲救护中心的 298 只黑猩猩、动物园的 1,030 只和研究机构的 442 只。校正年龄后，动物园与研究机构的成年个体在雌雄中体重都高于救护中心个体；救护中心队列的估计生长速度较慢。各组包含不同或未知亚种，照护环境也不同，因此不能把该比较当作野生形态或亚种间差异。

title.en: A model of deep population history
title.zh: 关于深层种群史的模型

text.en: A whole-genome site-pattern study sampled four chimpanzee lineages—central, eastern, Nigeria–Cameroon and western—alongside bonobos. Its best-fitting model estimated gene flow from western into eastern chimpanzees and placed the shared ancestor of the four sampled chimpanzee lineages at about 987,000 years ago. These are model-based population-history estimates with competing histories discussed by the authors, not dates from fossils.
text.zh: 一项全基因组位点模式研究在倭黑猩猩之外，还采样了中部、东部、尼日利亚—喀麦隆和西部四个黑猩猩谱系。拟合最佳的模型估计西部向东部黑猩猩发生过基因流动，并将四个受采样黑猩猩谱系的共同祖先时间估为约 987,000 年前。这些是种群史模型估计，作者也讨论了其他可能历史；它们不是化石定年结果。

title.en: A regional conservation estimate, not a current census
title.zh: 区域保育模型不是当前普查

text.en: A spatial model estimated 128,760 weaned central chimpanzees in Western Equatorial Africa in 2013 (95% CI 114,208–317,039); it estimated that 80.7% of this subspecies in the modeled region was outside the protected-area network. The result concerns one subspecies and a historical model period. The IUCN assessment linked above is version 2016-2, with errata published in 2018; its Endangered category is not presented as a verified current status.
text.zh: 一项空间模型估算，2013 年西赤道非洲的中部黑猩猩亚种有 128,760 只已断奶个体（95% 置信区间：114,208–317,039）；模型还估计该区域内 80.7% 的这一亚种个体位于保护区网络之外。结果只针对一个亚种和历史模型时期。上文所引 IUCN 评估为 2016-2 版，2018 年发布勘误；其中的“濒危”类别并未被当作经核实的当前状态。

title.zh: Humle 等（2016）：Pan troglodytes，《IUCN 受威胁物种红色名录》2016-2 版。

title.zh: Curry 等（2023）：不同照护环境下圈养黑猩猩的体重与生长速度。

scope.zh: 比较救护中心、动物园与研究机构队列；亚种混合或未知，不是野生体型估计。

title.zh: Strindberg 等（2018）：武器、病原与森林影响西赤道非洲大猩猩和黑猩猩的密度与分布。

readerLimitations.en: This reader draft brings together selected studies, not a complete species review. The available sources do not provide a current range or conservation assessment, or a broad wild diet, locomotion and morphology synthesis. The scientific dossier remains incomplete and has not received external expert review.

geography: Buxa Tiger Reserve, West Bengal, India (one troop study site)
Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico (managed free-ranging morphology study population)
overview: COL26.8 usage 3WWNQ is the accepted species record for Macaca mulatta. This reader brings together Chinese genetic samples and bounded studies in India and Cayo Santiago; none alone defines the species-wide ecology or population trend.

ecology.diet: At Buxa, fruit accounted for 70.8% of recorded diet in the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% in the October–April provisioning period for one 64-individual troop.
ecology.habitat: The selected Buxa troop home range included patches of natural forest, mixed-species plantations and residential settlements; this is one local study setting, not a full habitat account.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.bodySize: The Buxa ecology study did not estimate species-wide body size; see the separate Cayo Santiago morphology claim for its measured cohort.
ecology.guild: Not assessed in the selected studies.

traits: In one 2015 Cayo Santiago pedigree sample, most measured male morphometric traits were heritable under the study’s pooled models; this cohort result is not species-wide.
evidenceSummary: Selected evidence spans Chinese population genomics, one Buxa troop, managed Cayo Santiago cohorts and one NH-7 road segment. The 54 road deaths recorded in 2009–2010 are a local count, not a population mortality estimate or current conservation assessment.

title.en: One species, several study populations
title.zh: 同一物种，不同研究群体

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca mulatta. The studies brought together here sampled wild macaques in China and India, plus managed free-ranging groups at Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico. These settings answer different questions and should not be combined into one range-wide ecological portrait.
text.zh: 固定版本 COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca mulatta。本文选取的研究分别采样了中国与印度的野生恒河猴，以及波多黎各圣地亚哥岛受管理的自由活动群体。这些地点回答的是不同问题，不能拼成一幅覆盖全分布区的生态画像。

title.en: Genetic lineages in Chinese samples
title.zh: 中国样本中的遗传谱系

text.en: A population-genomic study sampled 81 wild rhesus macaques at 17 sites across China, representing five subspecies. The analysis identified five genetic lineages and reported evidence of recent gene flow. These results describe the sampled Chinese populations and the study’s models, not a complete global species tree or range map.
text.zh: 一项群体基因组研究在中国 17 个地点采集了 81 只野生恒河猴，涵盖五个亚种。分析识别出五个遗传谱系，并报告近期基因流动的证据。结果限于受采样的中国种群及论文所用模型，不是完整的全球物种树或分布图。

title.en: Seasonal feeding at Buxa
title.zh: 布克萨群体的季节性取食

text.en: Researchers followed one 64-member troop near Buxa Tiger Reserve from October 2013 to September 2014. Fruit made up 70.8% of recorded diet during the study-defined May–September non-provisioning period and 28.8% during the October–April provisioning period. Mean daily travel was 4.72 km and 2.58 km respectively; the comparison does not separate every seasonal influence.
text.zh: 研究者于 2013 年 10 月至 2014 年 9 月跟踪了布克萨虎保护区附近一个 64 只群体。按该研究定义，5–9 月非投喂期的记录饮食中水果占 70.8%，10–4 月投喂期占 28.8%；两期平均日活动距离分别为 4.72 公里和 2.58 公里。这个比较不能排除所有季节因素。

title.en: What a Cayo Santiago pedigree measured
title.zh: 圣地亚哥岛谱系样本测量了什么

text.en: A 2015 Cayo Santiago sample measured 125 adult males and 21 female relatives. Under the study’s pooled pedigree models, several male traits—including body mass, crown–rump length and canine length—met the authors’ heritability criterion; testicular volume did not, and its estimate was imprecise. This managed population is not a morphology survey of macaques throughout their native range.
text.zh: 2015 年圣地亚哥岛样本测量了 125 只成年雄性和 21 只雌性亲属。在论文合并谱系模型中，体重、头臀长和犬齿长等若干雄性特征达到作者设定的遗传率标准；睾丸体积未达到，且估计区间较宽。这一受管理群体不能代表原生分布区的整体形态调查。

title.en: Mating-season records at Cayo Santiago
title.zh: 圣地亚哥岛的交配季记录

text.en: During the 2013 mating season, a study followed 21 high-ranking males aged 7–21 years across nine provisioned, semi-free-ranging groups. Older males were associated with fewer offspring recorded by the study. Paternity was sampled when offspring reached one year, so infants that died earlier were not assigned to sires; the result is not lifetime reproductive success.
text.zh: 一项研究在 2013 年交配季跟踪了来自九个补饲半自由活动群体的 21 只高等级雄性，年龄为 7–21 岁。研究记录中，年龄较大的雄性对应较少后代。亲子鉴定在幼体满一岁时进行，采样前死亡的幼体没有归属父亲，因此结果不是终生繁殖成功率。

title.en: Road deaths on one Indian highway
title.zh: 印度一段公路上的死亡记录

text.en: From August 2009 to July 2010, observers recorded 54 rhesus macaques killed along an 11-km section of National Highway 7 near Pench: 27 in summer, 19 in winter and eight in the monsoon. Associations with traffic and roadside feeding are local observations, not a population mortality rate or a current threat assessment.
text.zh: 2009 年 8 月至 2010 年 7 月，观察者在潘奇附近国家公路 7 号一段 11 公里路段记录到 54 只恒河猴死亡：夏季 27 只、冬季 19 只、季风期 8 只。与车流和路边投喂的关联是局地观察，不是种群死亡率或当前受威胁评估。

Global distribution, fossil record and formal conservation status remain unassessed; the dossier is incomplete and has not received independent expert review.

title.en: A name is not a range assessment
title.zh: 分类名不是分布评估

text.en: The pinned COL26.8 checklist accepts Papio anubis. The studies selected here come from a captive research station in France, wild long-term records at Gombe and a survey-method study at Lake Manyara. They illuminate different parts of baboon biology but do not describe every population.
text.zh: 固定版本 COL26.8 接受名为 Papio anubis。本文选取的研究分别来自法国圈养研究站、贡贝的野生长期记录，以及曼雅拉湖的调查方法研究。它们照亮狒狒生物学的不同侧面，但不代表所有种群。

title.en: Growth from infancy in a captive cohort
title.zh: 圈养队列从幼年到成年的生长

text.en: A seven-year longitudinal study at the CNRS primatology station followed 14 females and 16 males from at least two months of age to adulthood. Measured size and shape were similar at birth; later differences in growth rate and duration produced substantial size differences while the measured body-shape pattern remained similar. This is a captive cohort, not a wild growth curve.
text.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心灵长类研究站的一项七年纵向研究，跟踪了 14 只雌性和 16 只雄性，从至少两月龄观察到成年。出生时测量的体型和形状相近；之后生长速度和持续时间不同，形成明显体型差异，而测量到的身体形状模式仍相近。这是圈养队列，不是野外生长曲线。

title.en: Miscarriage records at Gombe
title.zh: 贡贝的流产记录

text.en: Gombe records from 1972–2002 covered 732 pregnancies among 175 females of known rank; 65 pregnancies ended in miscarriage. The study found that rank-related patterns varied with rainfall and the immigration of males that rose rapidly to the highest rank. When mean rainfall over two years fell below about 1,100 mm, the rank-linked pattern largely disappeared. These observational associations are not a species-wide miscarriage rate or proof of cause.
text.zh: 贡贝 1972–2002 年记录涵盖 175 只已知等级雌性的 732 次妊娠，其中 65 次以流产告终。研究发现，等级相关模式会随降雨和快速升至最高等级的移入雄性而变化；当两年平均降雨低于约 1,100 毫米时，等级关联模式大体消失。这些观察性关联不是全物种流产率，也不能证明因果。

title.en: Why road surveys can overestimate density
title.zh: 为什么道路调查可能高估密度

text.en: At Lake Manyara, Tanzania, road-transect surveys from 2011–2019 produced density estimates more than three times an upper limit derived from sleeping-site counts and average group size. The authors pointed to baboons’ use of roads as a possible source of bias. This is a warning about one survey method at one site, not an estimate of the park’s total population or its trend.
text.zh: 坦桑尼亚曼雅拉湖 2011–2019 年道路样线调查得出的密度估计，超过根据夜宿点计数和平均群体大小推算上限的三倍。作者指出狒狒使用道路可能造成偏差。这是对一个地点一种调查方法的警示，不是公园总种群或其变化趋势的估计。

title.en: A 12-animal comparative genomic panel
title.zh: 由 12 只个体组成的比较基因组面板

text.en: A Papio phylogeny study sampled two animals from each of six extant baboon species, 12 individuals in total. Within that panel, the authors identified 4,645 Alu insertion sites as P. anubis indicator loci under their method. This result describes a comparative sample and a particular marker system; it does not summarize genetic variation within the species or settle its complete evolutionary history.
text.zh: 一项 Papio 系统发育研究按其设计为六个现生狒狒种各采样两只，共 12 只个体。在这一面板中，作者按其方法将 4,645 个 Alu 插入位点识别为 P. anubis 指示位点。结果描述的是特定比较样本和标记系统，不能概括该物种内部的遗传变异，也不能定论其完整演化史。

title.en: What remains outside these studies
title.zh: 这些研究尚未覆盖什么

text.en: The selected sources do not establish the species’ current distribution, formal conservation status, a wild species-wide diet or locomotion synthesis, or a complete fossil and evolutionary history. The dossier remains incomplete and has not received independent expert review.
text.zh: 所选来源没有确定该物种的当前分布、正式保育状态、野外全物种饮食或运动方式综合，也没有提供完整化石记录和演化史。科学档案仍未完成，且尚未经过独立专家评审。

overview: COL26.8 accepted usage 3WWP2 identifies Macaca radiata. Local forest, roadside and temple-site records from southern India, together with one cross-species museum comparison, describe selected questions rather than a current range or species-wide population trend.

ecology.diet: Not assessed in the selected study.
ecology.habitat: At Parambikulam, 54 groups were detected in 33 of 64 grid cells and modelled mean occupancy was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE); this is one forest survey, not a complete habitat account.

ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: Selected evidence includes a 2017 southern India survey and one 2018 interspecific craniodental comparison with 79 bonnet-macaque specimens. The latter does not establish within-species diagnostic variation; life history, species-range limits and current formal conservation status remain unassessed, and this profile has not received independent expert review.

title.en: Local records, not a range-wide census
title.zh: 地方记录不是全分布区普查

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca radiata. The evidence summarized here comes from selected southern Indian forests, roads and human-use sites, plus museum specimens used in a comparison across macaque species. It does not provide a current map or a complete population trend.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca radiata。本文概述的证据来自印度南部若干森林、道路和人类活动地点，另有用于猕猴属种间比较的博物馆标本。这些材料没有给出当前分布图或完整种群趋势。

title.en: A forest occupancy estimate at Parambikulam
title.zh: Parambikulam 的森林占域估计

text.en: In one survey of the Parambikulam landscape in Kerala, observers detected 54 groups in 33 of 64 grid cells. The fitted mean cell-occupancy estimate was 0.51 ± 0.08 (SE), with detection probability 0.25 ± 0.05. These estimates belong to that forest survey and its sampling design.
text.zh: 喀拉拉邦 Parambikulam 景观的一次调查中，研究者在 64 个网格中的 33 个记录到 54 个群体。模型估计平均网格占域率为 0.51 ± 0.08（标准误），检测概率为 0.25 ± 0.05。这些估计只适用于该次森林调查及其抽样设计。

title.en: Roadside counts connected to Mysore
title.zh: 连接迈索尔的路边计数

text.en: The study’s roadside counts fell from 889 in 2003 to 407 in 2015 on roads connected to Mysore. The 2015 resurvey covered 464 km and used a 15-m strip on each side of the road centreline. A roadside count measures animals visible within a defined survey band; the change is not a census of the species across southern India.
text.zh: 该研究在连接迈索尔的道路上记录的路边数量，从 2003 年的 889 只降至 2015 年的 407 只。2015 年复查覆盖 464 公里，调查带为道路中心线两侧各 15 米。路边计数反映的是规定调查带内可见的个体变化，不是对印度南部全物种的普查。

title.en: Temple and tourist-site histories
title.zh: 寺庙与旅游地点的历史记录

text.en: The same paper compared selected southern Indian temple and tourist locations over historical records and follow-up surveys from 2009–2015. About 31% of assessed locations recorded bonnet macaques; among reported translocation cases, roughly one fifth were followed by reappearance, while more than 48% were recorded as disappearance or removal. These site histories do not describe present-day occupancy across the full range.
text.zh: 同一论文比较了印度南部部分寺庙和旅游地点的历史记录及 2009–2015 年复查。约 31% 的受评地点记录到冠猕猴；在报告的迁移案例中，约五分之一随后有重新出现记录，超过 48% 被记录为消失或清除。这些地点史不能代表当前全分布区的占域情况。

title.en: Bonnet macaques in a museum comparison
title.zh: 种间博物馆比较中的冠猕猴标本

text.en: A 2018 comparison covered 711 museum specimens from 12 macaque species, including 79 M. radiata specimens (46 male and 33 female) attributed to southern and western India; subadults were also included. The paper reported a weak interspecific latitudinal pattern. Its mixed specimen origins and cross-species design do not establish diagnostic traits or variation within bonnet macaques.
text.zh: 一项 2018 年比较研究纳入 12 种猕猴的 711 件博物馆标本，其中 79 件冠猕猴标本（雄性 46 件、雌性 33 件）标注来自印度南部和西部，也包括亚成体。论文报告了较弱的种间纬度模式。标本来源不一且研究设计针对种间比较，不能据此确定冠猕猴的诊断性状或种内变异。

title.en: What these studies leave open
title.zh: 这些研究仍未回答什么

text.en: The selected sources do not synthesize the species’ life history, diet, locomotion, full distribution or current formal conservation category. A local recommendation in the 2017 article is not a statutory designation or an independently verified current status.
text.zh: 所选来源尚未综合该物种的生活史、饮食、运动方式、完整分布或当前正式保育类别。2017 年论文提出的地方性建议不是法定指定，也不是独立核实的当前状态。

scope.zh: 12 种猕猴 711 件博物馆标本的种间比较；其中 79 件为 M. radiata。

The dossier is incomplete and has not received independent expert review.

geography: Western Ghats, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu, India (15 named sampling sites, 2010–2012; wild fecal samples)
Puthuthottam forest fragment, Valparai plateau, Tamil Nadu, India (one troop; February–May 2016 study site)
overview: COL26.8 accepted species usage 3WWP6 identifies Macaca silenus (Linnaeus, 1758).

ecology.diet: At Puthuthottam, the studied troop consumed plant parts from 19 plant species and other non-plant foods; plant feeding was greater in the forest interior than at the forest edge, while invertebrate feeding was greater in the open patch than in the interior. This is a single-troop dry-season result.
ecology.habitat: During over 480 follow-hours in one habituated troop, active foraging was higher in the open forest patch and forest edge, and lower in the human settlement than in the forest interior; the activity budget differed between interior and settlement. One troop was observed from February to May 2016.
ecology.locomotion: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.bodySize: Not assessed in the selected studies.
ecology.guild: Not assessed as a broader species-level ecological guild.

evidenceSummary: The ecological observations come from one habituated troop during the 2016 dry season; genetic sampling and a separate four-group preprint have different scopes. Together these sources remain incomplete and do not provide a range-wide or annual ecological synthesis.

title.en: Sampling across the Western Ghats
title.zh: 西高止山脉的采样记录

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Macaca silenus. A 2010–2012 genetic study collected wild fecal samples at 15 sites in Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu; it also analyzed separately identified captive blood samples. These records document sampled places, not the complete present-day range.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Macaca silenus。一项 2010–2012 年遗传研究在卡纳塔克邦、喀拉拉邦和泰米尔纳德邦的 15 个地点采集野生粪便样本，另有单独标注的圈养血液样本。地点记录描述的是采样范围，不是完整的当前分布区。

title.en: Activity in a forest-fragment matrix
title.zh: 森林碎片景观中的活动

text.en: From February to May 2016, researchers logged more than 480 follow-hours for one habituated group at Puthuthottam, Tamil Nadu, across forest interior, edge, an open patch and a human settlement. Active foraging was higher in the open patch and at the edge, and lower in the settlement than in the interior. This is one group in one dry-season study.
text.zh: 2016 年 2–5 月，研究者在泰米尔纳德邦 Puthuthottam 跟踪一个习惯化群体，累计超过 480 小时，观察地点包括森林内部、边缘、开阔斑块和人类聚居地。开阔斑块和林缘的主动觅食较多；聚居地低于森林内部。这是一项单群体、旱季研究。

title.en: Foods recorded in the same troop
title.zh: 同一群体记录到的食物

text.en: The Puthuthottam troop ate parts from 19 plant species as well as non-plant foods. In the study’s habitat comparisons, invertebrate feeding was more frequent in the open patch than in forest interior, while plant feeding was greater in the interior than at the edge. These observations should not be read as a complete species diet.
text.zh: Puthuthottam 群体取食了 19 种植物的不同部分，也摄食非植物食物。按该研究的栖地比较，无脊椎动物取食在开阔斑块多于森林内部；植物取食在森林内部多于林缘。这些观察不能当作全物种的完整食谱。

title.en: A four-group seed-dispersal preprint
title.zh: 四个群体的种子传播预印本

text.en: A 2024 bioRxiv version-one preprint reports 375.9 hours of focal observations across four groups in a 92-ha Puduthottam fragment. Subadults consumed a greater variety of native and non-native fruits than adult males or females, and dispersed fewer Ficus seeds than adult females. The sampling year was not reported; this result has not been certified by peer review.
text.zh: 一篇 2024 年 bioRxiv 第一版预印本报告，在 Puduthottam 一处 92 公顷森林碎片中，对四个群体开展了 375.9 小时焦点观察。亚成体取食的本地与非本地水果种类多于成年雄性或雌性，传播的 Ficus 种子少于成年雌性。论文未报告采样年份；结果尚未经同行评审。

title.en: Mitochondrial lineages around the Palghat Gap
title.zh: Palghat 缺口两侧的线粒体谱系

text.en: The Western Ghats study distinguished sampled lineages north and south of the Palghat Gap. A fossil-calibrated model using 893 mitochondrial bases estimated a mean most-recent common ancestor at 2.11 million years. That model is not a nuclear-genome species tree or a direct fossil date for the origin of M. silenus.
text.zh: 西高止山脉研究区分了 Palghat 缺口南北受采样的线粒体谱系。一个以 893 个线粒体碱基为基础、经化石校准的模型，将最近共同祖先时间均值估为 211 万年前。这不是核基因组物种树，也不是 M. silenus 起源的直接化石年代。

title.en: Genetic diversity in forest fragments
title.zh: 森林碎片中的遗传多样性

text.en: A separate comparison of HVR-I mitochondrial samples from eight Anamalai forest fragments found lower diversity than in nearby continuous-forest samples. This comparison describes those samples and markers; it does not directly measure current population viability or predict extinction risk.
text.zh: 另一项研究比较了阿纳马莱八个森林碎片的 HVR-I 线粒体样本，发现其多样性低于邻近连续森林样本。该比较描述的是这些样本和标记，不能直接测量当前种群存续能力或预测灭绝风险。

title.en: What remains to be assessed
title.zh: 仍待评估的内容

text.en: The selected studies do not synthesize body size, life history, a complete range, annual ecology or current formal conservation status. The ecological findings come from one group and season; the seed-dispersal result remains a preprint. The scientific dossier is incomplete and has not received independent expert review.
text.zh: 所选研究尚未综合体型、生活史、完整分布区、全年生态或当前正式保育状态。生态发现来自一个群体和一个季节；种子传播结果仍为预印本。科学档案尚未完成，也未经过独立专家评审。

title.en: Catalogue of Life COL26.8, usage 3WWP6

title.en: A coat pattern described from adult samples
title.zh: 来自成体样本的毛色描述

text.en: A Brazilian study sampled 30 adult C. jacchus among 209 adult Callithrix specimens collected from mixed wild and captive sources during 2015–2019. It described grey-tipped crown hairs, a grey chin, white ear tufts and a prominent forehead star, with dark or grey dorsal bands over orange underfur. In the sampled adult comparison, mean values for 13 measured traits did not differ significantly from C. penicillata. These are comparative sample descriptions, not a stand-alone field diagnosis; hybrids may show overlapping pelage.
text.zh: 一项巴西研究在 2015–2019 年采集的 209 只成年柽柳猴中纳入 30 只普通狨，样本来源混有野生与圈养个体。论文描述其额顶部前半部毛尖多为灰色、颏部灰色、耳周有蓬松白色耳簇、额头有明显白色星斑，背部黑色或灰白色上毛覆盖橙色底毛。在该成体比较样本中，13 项测量的均值与黑耳狨（C. penicillata）没有显著差异。这些是样本中的比较性描述，不是单独的野外确诊标准；杂交个体的毛色可能重叠。

title.en: Native and introduced records in Brazil
title.zh: 巴西的原生与引入记录

text.en: The study’s occurrence-only compilation treated coastal and inland records in northeastern Brazil as native, and records in São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais as introductions. Observed locations, modeled habitat suitability and a complete range are different kinds of evidence. The compiled records do not set exhaustive range limits or prove absence elsewhere.
text.zh: 该研究仅含出现记录的资料汇编，将巴西东北部沿海与内陆记录列为原生区域，将圣保罗、巴拉那、里约热内卢和米纳斯吉拉斯的记录列为引入区域。实际出现地点、模型预测的栖地适宜性和完整分布范围是不同类型的证据；这份汇编不能确定完整边界，也不能证明其他地区没有分布。

title.en: A captive study of fathers and infant outcomes
title.zh: 圈养研究中的父亲照料与幼体结果

text.en: At one Wisconsin research colony, 24 experienced fathers and 62 offspring were included in a study of responses to infant distress calls. Offspring of fathers classified as responsive had higher survival beyond one month (p = 0.002); the paper also reported group weight differences at weeks 28 and 30. This is an association from one captive-colony study, not a wild survival estimate or proof that the response caused the outcome.
text.zh: 威斯康星一处研究圈养群体中，研究纳入 24 位有育幼经验的父亲及 62 只幼体，比较父亲对幼体求救叫声的反应。被归为会回应的父亲，其幼体超过一个月后的存活率较高（p = 0.002）；论文还报告第 28 和 30 周两组体重有差异。这是单一圈养群体中的关联，不是野外存活率估计，也不能证明父亲的反应造成了该结果。

title.en: What Brazilian rabies surveillance can show
title.zh: 巴西狂犬病监测能说明什么

text.en: Brazilian Ministry of Health passive surveillance recorded 67 rabies outbreaks affecting common marmosets, with 91 cases across 41 municipalities from January 2008 through October 2020. The study reported spillover of a Desmodus rotundus antigenic variant to C. jacchus in northern and southern reporting areas. These records describe reported outbreaks and an identified pathogen interaction; they do not measure disease prevalence throughout the species’ range.
text.zh: 巴西卫生部被动监测资料记录，2008 年 1 月至 2020 年 10 月，41 个市镇报告了影响普通狨的 67 起狂犬病疫情，共 91 例。研究还报告在北部和南部报告区域出现了吸血蝠（Desmodus rotundus）抗原变异株向普通狨的溢出。这些记录说明的是报告疫情和已识别的病原相互作用，不是该物种全分布区的患病率测量。

title.en: A conservation question involving introduced relatives
title.zh: 引入近缘种带来的保育问题

text.en: In a sample of 18 free-living marmosets with putative hybrid appearance from four southeastern Brazilian localities, five carried a C. jacchus maternal COX2 haplotype. The study discusses hybridization between native threatened C. aurita and introduced congeners, including the common marmoset, as a conservation concern. The sample does not estimate hybridization frequency in C. jacchus, measure population effects or establish the common marmoset’s conservation status.
text.zh: 一项研究在巴西东南部四个地点采集的 18 只自由活动、外形疑似杂交的绒猴中，检出 5 只带有普通狨母系 COX2 单倍型。论文将原生受威胁种 C. aurita 与包括普通狨在内的引入近缘种之间的杂交列为保育关注。该样本没有估计普通狨种群中的杂交频率或种群影响，也不能确定普通狨自身的保育状态。

title.en: A mitochondrial lineage estimate, not a species origin date
title.zh: 线粒体谱系估计不是物种起源日期

text.en: A study combining 49 newly sequenced Callithrix mitogenomes with published sequences estimated that sampled C. jacchus and the Caatinga lineage of C. penicillata were sister lineages that diverged about 0.51 million years ago. The estimate depends on the sampled mitochondrial lineages and model. It is not a nuclear-genome species tree or a definitive date for the origin of C. jacchus.
text.zh: 一项研究将 49 个新测序的柽柳猴属线粒体基因组与已发表序列合并，估计该研究采样的普通狨与黑耳狨卡廷加支系互为姐妹谱系，约在 51 万年前分化。这个估计受线粒体谱系采样和模型限制，不是核基因组物种树，也不是普通狨确定的起源日期。

title.en: A species page built from selected ancient samples
title.zh: 从若干古代样本组织的物种页

text.en: The COL26.8 checklist accepts Homo sapiens. The studies below examine particular fossils, archaeological contexts and population-genomic samples. They address different questions and cannot be combined into a single complete account of human origins, present-day diversity or migration.
text.zh: COL26.8 接受名为 Homo sapiens。下列研究考察特定化石、考古环境和群体基因组样本，各自回答不同问题，不能拼成一套完整的人类起源、当代多样性或迁徙叙事。

title.en: Two fossils at Tam Pà Ling
title.zh: Tam Pà Ling 的两件化石

text.en: At Tam Pà Ling cave in northern Laos, TPL 6 is a left frontal-bone fragment and TPL 7 a proximal left tibia, both attributed to H. sapiens by the study. Sediment models gave ages of 70 ± 3 ka for TPL 6 and as old as 77 ± 9 ka for TPL 7; these are contextual sediment estimates, not direct fossil dates. The authors note that TPL 7 may be older than the model’s oldest estimate, and taphonomic alteration limits its measurement.
text.zh: 老挝北部 Tam Pà Ling 洞穴的 TPL 6 是左额骨碎片，TPL 7 是左侧胫骨近端，论文将两者归为 H. sapiens。沉积年代模型给出 TPL 6 为 70 ± 3 千年、TPL 7 最早可达 77 ± 9 千年；这是周边沉积物的背景估计，不是化石直接测年。作者指出 TPL 7 可能早于模型最老估计，埋藏改造也限制了其骨骼测量。

title.en: Diet evidence from one cave at Ranis
title.zh: Ranis 一处洞穴提供的饮食证据

text.en: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, Germany, researchers analyzed collagen isotopes from 10 human remains with 52 animal remains from the same archaeological setting. The signal points to a diet dominated by large terrestrial mammals in a cold steppe–tundra environment. Layer dates are about 47,500–45,770 and 46,820–43,260 calibrated years before present; they are not direct dates for each human bone. One cave sample cannot define human diets generally.
text.zh: 德国 Ranis 的 Ilsenhöhle 洞穴中，研究者分析了 10 份人类遗骸的胶原同位素，并结合相同考古环境的 52 份动物遗骸。信号指向寒冷草原—苔原环境中以大型陆生哺乳动物为主的饮食。相关地层年代约为距今 47,500–45,770 年和 46,820–43,260 年（校正值），不是每块人骨的直接年代。一处洞穴样本不能定义一般人类饮食。

title.en: Ancient genomes south of the Limpopo
title.zh: 林波波河以南的古基因组

text.en: A whole-genome study analyzed 28 individuals from archaeological sites south of the Limpopo River in central and southern Africa, dated from 10,200 to 150 calibrated years before present. In the study’s comparison panel, samples older than 1,400 years fell outside the range of genetic variation represented by its modern-human samples and carried many variants the authors classified as H. sapiens-specific. This result depends on the sampled individuals, comparison panel and variant definitions.
text.zh: 一项全基因组研究分析了林波波河以南中部和南部非洲考古地点的 28 名个体，年代为距今 10,200 至 150 年（校正值）。在该研究的比较面板中，早于 1,400 年的样本落在其现代人样本所代表遗传变异范围之外，并带有许多作者归类为 H. sapiens 特异的变异。结果取决于受采样个体、比较面板和变异定义。

title.en: The directly dated Ust’-Ishim individual
title.zh: 直接测年的 Ust’-Ishim 个体

text.en: The Ust’-Ishim 1 femur from western Siberia was directly radiocarbon dated to 46,880–43,210 calibrated years before present at 95.4% probability. Its genome belongs to this one dated individual. The result is not a date for the origin of H. sapiens or a first-and-last occurrence interval for the species.
text.zh: 来自西西伯利亚的 Ust’-Ishim 1 股骨经直接放射性碳测年，95.4% 概率区间为距今 46,880–43,210 年（校正值）。其基因组对应这一名受测个体。该结果不是 H. sapiens 的起源年代，也不是物种首末出现时间范围。

title.en: Keep the sites and questions separate
title.zh: 让不同地点与问题保持区分

text.en: The Laos fossils, Ranis dietary signal, Siberian individual and southern African genomes differ in place, age model and research question. Together they offer several windows into ancient H. sapiens, but they do not trace one continuous migration route or provide a current geographic range.
text.zh: 老挝化石、Ranis 饮食信号、西伯利亚个体和南部非洲古基因组，在地点、年代模型和研究问题上都不同。它们提供了观察古代 H. sapiens 的若干窗口，但不能构成一条连续迁徙路线，也不提供当前地理分布区。
